competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to inflict damage that increases as the enemy's HP decreases. Additionally, if there's Boomerang Warrior included in the ally team, one of Chakram Dancers will attack together with Boomerang Warrior during Boomerang Warrior's turn.

effets.description: Brings one or more allies to attack at the same time.

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects granted on yourself and increases your Attack Power for 2 turns. You instantly gain another turn after using the skill.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks an enemy target 2 times to replace all of the target's beneficial effects with continuous damage effects. Additionally decreases the enemy's HP by 5% each according to the number of continuous damage effects granted on the target, afterwards. Boomerang Warrior will inflict continuous damage on the enemy for 1 turn when they attack together.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
